goals.text: Find the guard who ran east down the road with the cage key.
Take the cage key back to Oskar at the wrecked wagon.
Climb past Wick's Rest to the Guttering Abbey, and get through the Tollwarden at its Gatehouse.
The Nave's great door wants four Seals. Take the Toll Key down to the Tallow Works, and find the Waxmire.
Win the Seal of Tallow in the depths of the Tallow Works.
Win the Seal of the Mire at the heart of the Waxmire.
Break through a cracked wall in the Tallow Works into the Powder Vault. Its Master Gunner keeps the Seal of Powder.
Blow the rubble off the collapsed gate on the Penance Road with a Keg Charge, and win the Seal of the Hive in Bloomhollow.
Bring the four Seals to the Nave's great door, and face the Chandler.
Go back down to Wick's Rest and tell Sister Maudlin that the Chandler is dead.
Act One is over. In the Nave, the lift's chains are humming, but it will not rise. Not yet.
